Distant cousins of the galka, the roegadyns are a maritime people known for enormous, muscular builds and unflinching courage.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Roegadyns gain +2 Strength, +2 Charisma, and -2 Dexterity.
  • Type: Roegadyns are humanoids with the roegadyn subtype.
  • Size: Roegadyns are Medium creatures.
  • Base Speed: Roegadyns have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Roegadyns begin play speaking Common and Roegadyn. Roegadyns with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Dwarven, Elvaan, Giant, Goblin, Lalafellan, and Orc.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Hardy: Roegadyns receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.
  • Powerful Build: Roegadyns function as one size category larger for many combat maneuver purposes.
  • Stability: Roegadyns receive a +4 bonus to their CMD when resisting a bull rush or trip attempt while standing on the ground.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Imposing Figure: Roegadyns gain a +2 racial bonus to Intimidate checks.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Cornered Fury: Roegadyns at half or fewer hit points with no ally within 30 feet gain a +2 racial bonus on melee attack rolls and AC.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Low-Light Vision: Roegadyns have low-light vision allowing them to see twice as far as humes in dim light.
